title: QA Automation Engineer
description: Move from testing fundamentals to API, UI, accessibility, performance, and CI-ready automation.

tree.name: Testing Foundations
tree.description: Learn test design, bug reporting, risk-based testing, SDLC, and quality mindset.

resources.title: Software Testing Course - Playwright, E2E, and AI Agents (freeCodeCamp)
Playwright MiniProject: End-to-End Automation (Automation Step by Step)

children.name: Test Cases and Bug Reports
children.description: Write clear scenarios, expected results, reproduction steps, severity, and priority.

children.name: Programming for Testers
children.description: Use JavaScript or Java for assertions, data setup, page objects, helpers, and CI scripts.

tree.name: API Testing
tree.description: Validate HTTP APIs, contracts, auth flows, status codes, payloads, and error behavior.

children.name: HTTP and REST
children.description: Understand verbs, headers, cookies, sessions, JSON schemas, idempotency, and pagination.

children.name: Contract and Schema Testing
children.description: Use schemas and contract tests so clients and services do not silently drift apart.

children.name: Practice: Bug Reproduction Lab
children.description: Turn vague bug reports into reproducible cases, automated checks, screenshots, and clear defect notes.

tree.name: UI Automation
tree.description: Automate realistic browser journeys with reliable selectors, fixtures, screenshots, and traces.

resources.title: Playwright Automation Tutorial for Beginners (Mukesh otwani)

children.name: Playwright Test
children.description: Use locators, fixtures, assertions, projects, traces, and parallel test execution.

children.name: Accessibility Checks
children.description: Add automated accessibility checks while still understanding what must be manually reviewed.

tree.name: Performance and CI
tree.description: Run automation in pipelines, track flaky tests, and test performance under realistic load.

children.name: Load Testing
children.description: Model users, thresholds, response times, throughput, and failure modes before launches.

children.name: Flaky Test Management
children.description: Debug unstable tests, improve selectors, isolate test data, quarantine failures, and track reliability metrics.

children.name: Project: Test Suite for a Web App
children.description: Create API, UI, accessibility, and load tests, then run them in CI with reports.
